get.summary: Export the project's guidance as format v5 (members)
get.description: Contains only the project's overrides with their base skill versions. With `includeDefaults=true` the effective text of every entry is included (defaults carry the current skill version).

post.summary: Replace the project's guidance overrides from an export (owners)
post.description: Accepts format `backlog-guidance` version 5, or a version 4 configuration export of the single-user app (principles, type instructions and templates; the free-text `instructions` field is ignored). Everything is validated first; all overrides are then replaced in one transaction. Entries identical to the current skill default are not stored, and entries missing from the document fall back to the default.
